# Uncle Abe

[Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea)

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P6](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0006)</sub>

- **Titles:** weather prophet  <sub>[v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P3](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

_Not yet known._

## Personality

Uncle Abe is a persistent weather prognosticator who continues to make prophecies regardless of his track record. Despite his dedication to predicting the weather, few of his forecasts are ever actually fulfilled, leading others to simply expect the opposite of what he predicts.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P9](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0009)_

## Traits

- weather prognosticator  <sub>[v2 XIV A Danger Averted P9](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0009)</sub>

## Goals

_Not yet known._

## History

After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) published a mock newspaper note regarding Uncle Abe's weather predictions, a severe hailstorm struck [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) on the exact day he had predicted. The storm caused massive devastation throughout the town, damaging crops, trees, and windows.

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P3](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0003), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043)_
